handbookNote: Florida Boating Safety Education Identification Card program (Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission / FWC) and Florida Statutes Chapter 327 -- Florida has no single official FWC-administered boating exam; FWC approves NASBLA-standard third-party courses (Boat-Ed, BOATERexam, BOATsmart!, etc.) whose embedded quiz is the de facto test, converging on a 60-question / 80%-to-pass format -- price matches this project's Motorcycle-tier boating convention ($7.99), not a placeholder
